name: eden-bench-v1
description: First EDEN benchmark: 12 small single-page React build requests, each optionally followed by one iterative edit request on the app it produced. Created 2026-10-25. Tasks are deliberately scoped to what EDEN's scaffold supports (React 18 + Vite, App.jsx + styles.css, no third-party packages).
clarification_answer: Keep it simple: a single page, no backend, use your best judgement on the details.

tasks.build: Build a counter app with increment, decrement and reset buttons.
tasks.edit: Make the counter stop at zero so it can never go negative.

tasks.build: Build a todo list app where I can add tasks, mark them complete, and delete them.
tasks.edit: Add filter buttons to show all, active, or completed tasks.

tasks.build: Build a tip calculator with bill amount, tip percentage and number of people that shows the total per person.
Build a stopwatch app with start, stop, lap and reset buttons and a list of lap times.
tasks.edit: Change the colour scheme to a light theme with dark text.

tasks.build: Build a Pomodoro timer with 25 minute work sessions and 5 minute breaks, with start, pause and reset.
Build a unit converter app that converts kilometres to miles and Celsius to Fahrenheit.
Build a random quote generator app with ten built-in quotes and a new quote button.
Build a two-player tic-tac-toe game that announces the winner and has a restart button.
tasks.edit: Add a scoreboard that keeps track of how many games X and O have won.

tasks.build: Build a notes app where I can add a note with a title and body, see all my notes in a list, and delete them.
Build a password strength checker app that shows a strength meter and tips for improving the password.
Build a BMI calculator app that takes height in centimetres and weight in kilograms and shows the BMI category.
tasks.edit: Add a toggle to switch between metric and imperial units, using pounds and inches.

tasks.build: Build a flashcard app with five built-in cards where I can flip a card to see the answer and go to the next or previous card.
tasks.edit: Add a shuffle button that randomises the card order.
